AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu.

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Vegetables? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Vegetables.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Vegetables.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Vegetables.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Vegetables.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Nutrients? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Nutrients.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Food Nutrients.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Nutrients.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Nutrients.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food Frying Frying? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food Frying Frying.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food Frying Frying.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food Frying Frying.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food Frying Frying.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Soil Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Wild Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Growing Vegetables and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
